Cardograph Support

Get help with your account, subscription, collection, scanner, prices, backups, or data controls.

Need help? Email essam@naburalabs.com. Include your phone platform, Cardograph version, the exact message shown, and what happened immediately before the problem.
Email supportSubscription helpScanner help

Contact support

When contacting support, include:

  1. The email address used for Cardograph.
  2. Whether you use iPhone or Android.
  3. Your Cardograph app version.
  4. The exact message shown by the app.
  5. The steps that happened before the problem.

Do not send your password, secure sign in link, complete payment card information, or a private collection export unless support specifically requests the relevant file.

Sign in help

Cardograph supports Google, Apple, and secure email links.

Email link does not arrive

  1. Confirm the email address.
  2. Check spam and junk folders.
  3. Request a new link and use only the newest link.
  4. Open the link on the phone where Cardograph is installed.

If Apple or Google sign in fails, confirm that the phone has internet access and that the provider account is active.

Cardograph Plus

Cardograph Plus offers two auto renewing options in the United States:

  1. USD 4.99 per month.
  2. USD 39.99 per year.

Eligible new subscribers can receive a three day free trial. Apple or Google determines eligibility and shows the final localized price, renewal date, taxes, and trial status before confirmation. There is no lifetime plan.

Restore a purchase

Use Restore Purchase on the Cardograph Plus screen when you reinstalled Cardograph, changed phones, completed a purchase that is not unlocking the app, or signed in again with the same store account.

Use the Apple Account or Google Play account that originally completed the purchase. Also sign in to the intended Cardograph account.

If restoration still fails, email essam@naburalabs.com with the platform, Cardograph account email, product selected, approximate purchase time, and the message shown. Do not send complete payment details.

Cancel a subscription

Important. Deleting Cardograph, logging out, or deleting a Cardograph account does not cancel a store subscription.

For Apple:

  1. Open Settings on the iPhone.
  2. Tap your name.
  3. Tap Subscriptions.
  4. Select Cardograph.
  5. Tap Cancel Subscription.

Use Apple subscription management or read Apple's cancellation instructions.

For Google Play:

  1. Open Google Play.
  2. Tap the profile icon.
  3. Open Payments and subscriptions.
  4. Open Subscriptions.
  5. Select Cardograph.
  6. Tap Cancel subscription.

Use Google Play subscription management or read Google Play's cancellation instructions.

Cancellation normally stops the next renewal while access continues through the current paid or trial period, unless the store, a refund, or applicable law provides otherwise.

Request a refund

Apple and Google process Cardograph purchases and decide refund eligibility under their policies.

For an Apple purchase, use Apple's refund request instructions. For a Google Play purchase, use Google Play's refund request process.

Contact essam@naburalabs.com if a completed purchase was not delivered or the subscription status shown by Cardograph appears incorrect.

Collection synchronization

A signed in Cardograph collection is saved on the phone and synchronizes automatically when an internet connection is available. If synchronization cannot connect, changes remain on the phone and Cardograph retries later.

If two devices changed independently, Cardograph can ask you to choose between the phone version and the cloud version. Export both versions before choosing if you might need information from each.

Do not uninstall Cardograph until important information has synchronized or been exported.

Export and backup

Cardograph provides:

  1. CSV export for card rows, notes, and costs.
  2. Complete JSON export for cards, binders, wants, trades, locations, and history.

Use JSON when you want a complete Cardograph backup. Use CSV when you want a table that can be opened in spreadsheet software. Keep exports in a location you control. Anyone with an export can read the collection information contained in it.

Camera and scanning help

For better recognition:

  1. Keep the card upright.
  2. Use even lighting.
  3. Avoid glare and strong reflections.
  4. Keep the title and collector number readable.
  5. Hold the phone steady until the border turns dark green.
  6. Review every card identity, printing, finish, and condition before saving.
  7. For a saved binder, rescan the known binder page instead of saving it as a new unfiled scan.

Cardograph processes camera frames on the phone. It does not save photos or upload live camera images. The scanner suggests a likely card identity. It does not authenticate, grade, or establish the condition of a card.

Reference prices

Cardograph retrieves catalog information and market references through TCGdex. The United States collection view uses matching TCGplayer reference values when an exact finish quote is available. Cardograph does not use active eBay listings as its current pricing source.

A reference price can be missing, stale, delayed, or mapped to a different printing or finish. It is not a guaranteed sale value, formal appraisal, or investment recommendation.

Missing cards or binders

Cardograph keeps separate collection areas for different signed in accounts and for older local guest data. Confirm that you are signed in with the same Cardograph account used when the cards or binders were saved.

Do not erase or reinstall the app while trying to recover missing data. Export the visible collection first and contact essam@naburalabs.com.

Erase local data

“Erase this collection from this phone” removes the selected local collection from that phone. It does not delete cloud data, another account, or offline copies on another device. Export a backup before confirming if you might need the information later.

Delete an account

“Delete account and cloud collection” removes the Cardograph account, its cloud collection, the current phone's copy of that account, and its Cardograph RevenueCat customer profile.

It does not cancel an Apple or Google subscription. Cancel the subscription separately through the store. Other devices can retain offline copies until those copies are erased on each device.
